QuestInfo.name: The Resistance's Invitation
QuestInfo.0: #p1101002# needs your help preparing for the continental conference.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# wants you to deliver an invitation to #p2152004#, a representative of the Resistance. It will be difficult to win the Resistance's trust...
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the letter to #p2152004#, but she didn't seem too happy. What will it take to win her over?

0.0: A continental conference isn't much good if we're the only ones who attend. We have to invite the leaders of other groups, like the Explorers and the Resistance.
0.1: I believe #p2152004# could be considered a leader of the Resistance. However, you could say the Resistance and the Cygnus Knights have some bad blood between them... She may not be easy to convince.
0.2: However, it wouldn't be a true alliance without the help of the Resistance. Please do whatever it takes to get them to accept our invitation.
0.3: Find the Resistance in #m310000000#. #p2152004# pretends to work as a doctor in town, but she's actually a high-ranking Resistance member. Find her and convince her to accept the invitation.\r\n\r\n(You will be moved to #m310000000# after you accept.)

no.0: I know you'd prefer a simple mission like 'Hit 10 pigs with a stick,' but this is important.

1.0: The doctor is OUT. If you need medical help, go see Wendelline... What's this?

yes.0: I don't know how you know about me, and I don't care. I'm not reading your letter; the Cygnus Knights have nothing to say that I want to hear.

npc.0: You can get a ride to #m310000000# from the Victoria Island Station.

item.0: You don't look like you need a doctor to me.
